Hi, Trainer!
Do you have a minute?{VAR BE01}

I heard the storm on Route 7 was caused
by a Pokémon!

The trembling before the Pokémon League
is a tremor of excitement!

Victory Road stands in the way of a
challenge to the Pokémon League.{VAR BE01}
You need to have serious skills
to get through it.
